timeline.summary: Suven Life Sciences announced achieving 76% enrollment in its Global Phase 3 Masupirdine trial for Alzheimer's agitation, with data readout expected by April 2027.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1.52 Cr (+3.4% YoY), net loss ₹45.6 Cr (against a loss of ₹43.94 Cr a year earlier).
Suven Life Sciences filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Suven Life Sciences received an income tax rectification order for AY 2020-21 disallowing R&D weighted deductions under Section 35(2AB).
Suven Life Sciences announced a positive DSMB safety review and interim analysis for its ongoing global Phase 3 study of Masupirdine.
